_doc: The first co-op drill (openspec/changes/coop-drill design 1). Text is what the briefing and debrief show. enemy_start_m is relative to the Tern, in its frame (+Z ahead). bot_ready_s is how long a bot client reads the briefing before it presses READY. muster_m is where the crew stand on the bridge before they walk to their seats (the back wall, deck A); muster_spacing_m between them.
title: Drill 1: Hound at the Shoals
situation: A Hound corvette has been raiding the relay at the Shoals. The Tern is ordered to intercept and disable it before it reaches the relay.
objectives: Keep the Tern's hull above zero

orders.helm: Close to turret range. Keep the Hound level with the ship so all four turrets bear, put the bow on it for missiles, and keep moving so it cannot aim.
orders.tactical: Lock the Hound, free the turrets, turn the strongest shield toward it, and fire Gannets when the bow is on it.
